title: Tag documents and filter the library by tag
objective: Let people tag documents. PUT /api/documents/:id/tags with { tags: [...] } replaces a document's tags (library members only, 404 otherwise). Tags are trimmed, 1 to 24 characters (else 400 { error: 'invalid_tag' }), at most 10 (else 400 { error: 'too_many_tags' }), and duplicates that differ only in case are dropped, keeping the first spelling. Tags belong to the library, so teammates see the same tags. GET /api/documents returns tags ([] when none). Each library row shows its tags as chips under the title (data-testid="tag-chip"). libraryPage(store, userId, { tag }) and ?tag= filter the library to one tag, ignoring case, and show a link to clear the filter (data-testid="clear-tag", href="/") only while filtering.
acceptance: Members set tags; the rules (trim, length, count, case-insensitive duplicates) hold on the server
Teammates see the same tags, and the API returns them
Rows show the tags as chips
Filtering by a tag ignores case and offers a clear-filter link
plan_summary: tags on the document (a schema change), a PUT route with a normaliser, chips and a tag filter in libraryPage and listDocuments.
